ops.en: HECHEL — the begin-root's second token, one verse after 4:26's huchal fork: whatever began at the calling, the multiplying begins here. The stage is PNEI HA-ADAMAH ('the ground's face') — the phrase 6:7 will close the bracket on: multiplied on it, wiped from it.
Passive and agentless (TIR-032): daughters WERE BORN — the chapter-5 ledger's bulk plural steps forward as the prologue's subject: the unnamed daughters become the story.

WHAT DID THE MULTIPLICATION BRING? [claim G15-07]. לָרֹב (larov) is read two ways and both are carried: R. Yochanan reads that PROPAGATION came into the world; Reish Lakish reads מְרִיבָה (meriva, 'STRIFE') came into the world. What the machine records as growth one seat reads as the arrival of conflict. [folded shape: recorded dispute]

BNEI HA-ELOHIM ('the sons of God') — the span's first open name [OPEN: divine beings vs judges/nobles — the chain's oldest war on this page; Onkelos votes 'sons of the GREAT ONES' and a named tanna anathematizes the literal reading — dual-track, named-only]. The machine stores the letter's phrase and no identity.

CREATURE-RUN #2 (gen_10's 3:6 precedent: the woman saw the tree ki tov): the week's verdict word fires in creature eyes and the machine records the CREATURE'S test, never a divine verdict — no divine token appears in this verse. The oracle word is the week's own; the subjects and the sequel are not.

ops.en: THE STOLEN FORMULA: the inspection grammar of the week — see + that-good — re-run with every slot mutated: the seer is plural and creaturely, the seen is human daughters, and where the Maker's seeing ended in blessing or rest, this seeing ends in seizure. The machine flags the mutation against the frozen week text and reads no identity into the seers.

The taking: LAQACH — 4:19's polygamy verb generalized from two wives to 'from ALL' — and BACHAR ('choose'): the corpus's FIRST TOKEN of choice, debuting as unlimited appetite (token 2 is Lot choosing the plain). The letter states no evaluation; the next verse answers.

A DISPUTE IN WHICH ONE SIDE CURSES THE OTHER [claim G15-08, machine-checked]. R. Shimon ben Yochai renders בְּנֵי הָאֱלֹהִים (benei ha-elohim) 'the sons of the JUDGES' and CURSES those who render it literally; the school of R. Yishmael reads the fallen ones and joins the scapegoat law to them, the goat atoning 'for the deeds of Uzza and Azael'. Both carried dual-track. An ink point rides with it: …
The divine voice returns — its first speech since the 4:15 decree.

To the question 'Moses - from where in the Torah?' the answer is בְּשַׁגַּם (be-shagam) of THIS verse: its letters total three hundred and forty-five, the same as מֹשֶׁה (Moshe) - and the clause continues 'his days shall be a hundred and twenty years', exactly Moses' lifespan. A CANONICAL VERDICT ROW DERIVED FROM THIS OPERATOR'S OWN TOKEN [claim G15-10]. The Mishnah rules that the generation of the Flood has no share in the world to come AND DOES NOT STAND IN JUDGMENT, stating its proof from this clause: לֹא יָדוֹן רוּחִי (lo yadon ruchi) - neither judgment nor spirit. The tannaim parse the clause four ways, and the semantic field is developed as no return of the spirit…

THE NUMBER IS A DEADLINE, NOT A LIFESPAN CAP [claim G15-11]. The hundred and twenty years are read as a GRACE PERIOD - 'You did not decree destruction until they consummated their evil' - and the period is filled with warning: the righteous man planting and felling cedars for the ark in full view of the generation, mocked as a contemptible old man. The grace carries its own limit, stated as a cont…

NEPHILIM — a name with exactly three Torah tokens (here + the spies' report, Num 13:33 x2) and no etymology offered by the letter [OPEN: the machine stores the name and nothing else — no fall, no giants, nothing invented]. The inspection verb comes home to its Subject — and returns the other verdict.

ops.x: flag: spec 'va-yar Elohim et-kol-asher asah ve-hinneh tov meod — He saw all He had made: very good (1:31, frozen day 6)' delivered 'va-yar YHWH ki rabbah raat ha-adam — He saw: GREAT was the EVIL of man (6:5)'
ops.en: THE INVERTED INSPECTION: the same seeing that closed the week on tov MEOD ('very good') returns rabbah RAAT ('great evil') — the superlative survives, the polarity does not. Flagged against the frozen day-6 text; the two seeings of this unit (6:2 stolen, 6:5 inverted) are the span's frame.

The total diagnosis, held verbatim: EVERY (kol) devising, ONLY (raq) evil, ALL (kol) the day — three quantifiers, no exception clause. YETZER ('form/inclination') debuts — its token 2 is 8:21, the flood's far-shore bookend, where the same word is spoken as a reason for never-again; MACHASHAVAH ('devising') debuts — its next tokens are the TABERNACLE craftsman's design-word (Exod 31:4, 35:32-33): t…

A DESCRIPTION READ AS A RUNNING PROCESS [claim G15-12]. The inclination-clause is read as a live adversary, not a disposition: it RENEWS DAILY, read out of this verse's 'all the day'; it overcomes a person daily and SEEKS TO KILL HIM, and were God not helping him he could not withstand it; and it is identified outright with the Accuser and with the angel of death, this verse's 'only evil all the d…

Every taking is individually below the actionable threshold, by design. And the sealing-cause is stated plainly: 'they violated ev…

NACHAM token 2 — gen_14's fuse detonates: 5:29 offered the root as hoped COMFORT; here it fires as divine REGRET, aimed at the make-verb itself (ki ASAH — the week's own doing-word). The corpus's first divine-interior event, logged because the letter logs it (wayyiqtol narrative verb — the machine records verbs, not psychology). Onkelos deletes it: 'the LORD TURNED in His WORD (Memra)' — dual-trac…

The ATZAV verb's first token (hitpael, reflexive) — and it is the ROOT of ITZAVON, the toil-noun of both Eden sentences and Lamech's hope (3:16, 3:17, 5:29 — the noun's only tokens): the pain sentenced on the humans arrives in the Sentencer's own heart. The heart-pair closes: man's heart all-evil (6:5), His heart grieved (6:6). Onkelos rewrites the clause into 'said in His Word to BREAK THEIR STRE…

THE VERB'S POLARITY IS DISPUTED [claim G15-14]. וַיִּנָּחֶם (va-yinachem) read as regret is the machine's plain sense; read as SOLACE it inverts - Rav Dimi: 'I did WELL that I prepared graves in the earth.' At the tannaitic seat the semantics are fixed as SECOND THOUGHTS. The parenthetical grief is read as aimed at His own heart. Both polarities carried on one operator. [folded shape: recorded dis…
The interior becomes speech.

EMCHEH ('I will WIPE') — the wipe-verb's debut, as a divine first-person resolve in the exact mood-grammar of the corpus's most constructive demand: 2:18's e'eseh ('I will MAKE') pushed CMD-US? and the building popped it (gen_09); 6:7 pushes I-WILL-WIPE and NOTHING IN THIS UNIT POPS IT — the execution waits at 7:23, outside. The corpus's first open demand for UN-creation: the queue debt rises to F…

The scope, held verbatim: human -> livestock -> creeper -> birds — the creation sequence walked BACKWARD (day 6's last-made first, then its animals, then day 5's birds): un-creation reads the build-list in reverse. ki NICHAMTI (nacham token 3) ki ASITIM — the double reason: regret aimed at the making, twice. The ground's-face bracket closes: multiplied on it (6:1), wiped from it (here).

WHY THE ANIMALS DIE, AND WHAT ELSE HAD STRAYED [claim G15-15]. The scope is argued by parable - the pedagogue punished with the pupil, the canopy dismantled when the son is lost - and pressed to its limits, even the dust of the first man, even the indestructible bone of the spine, with a recorded audience-refusal when it was preached. In the three-finds census this man is EXCLUDED, with a precise reason: 'HE found; the Holy One did not find HIM' - the favour flowing one way only.
